rules.moduleSpecificMinimum: Minimum 20 mature independent paired issuer-dates is evaluated per module lane; dates cannot be pooled across modules to satisfy the threshold.
rules.exactPair: A mature pair requires exact challenger knownAt plus frozen B0/B1 controls on the exact same issuer-decisionDate population.
rules.crossModuleDedup: The same issuer-decisionDate can appear in multiple module inventories but is one global information cluster for cross-module aggregation; it does not become multiple independent dates.
rules.episodeClustering: Related outlook/watch/downgrade or approval/pricing/issuance events require episode-cluster review before independence is claimed.
rules.unknown: Missing baseline, source time, scope, accounting basis or dependency remains UNKNOWN/blocked, never neutral.
rules.outcomes: No return/MFE/MAE labels are joined in this inventory.

counts.note: Global unique dates are descriptive only and cannot satisfy a per-module minimum. D22-05 has passed the challenger-side episode count gate but has zero mature paired dates until B0/B1 baseline pairing is frozen.
